// diagnostic

E0223

A mutable borrow of `{name}` cannot escape its persistent or static storage cell

What

A mutable borrow of `{name}` cannot escape its persistent or static storage cell

Why

Persistent and static state must be changed by computing a replacement and assigning the whole binding. A mutable borrow or mutating receiver would let access escape the cell.

Fix

Compute an owned replacement, then assign the persistent or static binding as a whole instead of passing `{name}` with `&` or using a mutating receiver.

Worked example
